title: Murhangeri La Hlawuriweke wa Rixaka
intro: Enkarhini wa ntlhontlho lowukulu ni ku heleriwa hi ntshembo eka vanhu, ku hlawuriwe hi Xikwembu. Munhu loyi, eku sunguleni a honisiwile hi vo tala, u hlawuriwile hi Allah leswaku a rhangela tiko ku lwisana ni nala la chavisaka. Mhaka ya vona i vumbhoni bya matimba ya ripfumelo ni vutlhari lebyi nga endzhaku ka xileriso xa Xikwembu, leswi kombisaka leswaku vurhangeri bya ntiyiso a hi minkarhi hinkwayo byi kumekaka etindhawini leti languteriweke.
clues: Ndzi hlawuriwile hi Allah ku va murhangeri eka vanhu va mina loko va lava mufumi ku lwa eka mhaka ya Yena.
Vanhu va mina eku sunguleni va kanakanile ku thoriwa ka mina, va vona onge van’wana va faneriwa ngopfu hikwalaho ka rifuwo ra vona kumbe rixaka ra vona.
Xikombiso xa vurhangeri bya mina lebyi faneleke a ku ri ku vuya ka bokisi ro kwetsima, leri a ri ri ni swilo leswi saleke leswi humaka eka vaprofeta va khale, leswi tiseke ku rhula.
Ndzi rhangele vuthu ra mina enambyeni, laha ndzi ringeteke ku yingisa ka vona hi ku va yirisa ku nwa mati lama tlulaka xikokovi xin’we.
Ku nga khathariseki nhlayo yitsongo ya lava va tshameke va tiyile endzhaku ka ndzingo, hi langutane ni nhenha ya matimba ni vuthu ra yona.
Ehansi ka vulawuri bya mina, muntshwa un’wana wa vuthu ra mina, loyi a a nga ri mulwi la dumeke, hi xivindzi u langutane ni nghwazi leyi chavisaka ya nala ivi yi hlula.

trial.label: Xikambelo/Xiendlakalo
options: Ku thoriwa tani hi murhangeri ku lwisana na xihontlovila
trial.answer: Ku thoriwa tani hi murhangeri ku lwisana na xihontlovila

outcome.label: Mbuyelo
options: Mfumo wu simekiwile hi rifuwo lerikulu swinene ni matimba.
Vanhu va nwile hi ndhambi leyikulu.
Nghwazi ya nala yi hluriwile, naswona Allah u nyike ku hlula.
Dyandza lerikulu ri hlasele tiko ku ringana malembe.
Murhangeri u mitiwe hi xivumbiwa lexikulu.
outcome.answer: Nghwazi ya nala yi hluriwile, naswona Allah u nyike ku hlula.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
